resources.string: PDF and image tools process documents on this device. Direct downloads contact only the addresses you choose. Jumlo does not automatically upload your documents.\n\nOriginals outside Jumlo change only through actions you confirm in granted folders. Items in managed trash remain until you confirm permanent deletion. Local diagnostics contain timestamps and error codes, without document contents, passwords or links.
Measured file sizes managed by Jumlo. Android may report a larger app total that also includes the app and its database.
Remove preview and extraction cache older than 7 days? Saved results, imported copies, trash and resumable jobs are kept.
